Official rules

The Haven Showcase

A page in StepHaven where a few havens at a time are shown for every player to visit. It isn't a contest, and nothing is ranked. It's a first version, and it may change as we learn.

First Edition

How it works

  1. Step 1
    Put your name down
    Finish the tutorial and play on 3 different days
  2. Step 2
    Get invited
    A letter arrives with the Gilded Passport cover
  3. Step 3
    Send a haven in
    From its passport, by December 10, 2026
  4. Step 4
    Watch your mailbox
    We write back. Shown havens go on the page

Havens can be sent in and updated until the end of December 10, 2026, US Pacific time. Havens on the page stay open for visits after that. The page has no closing date.

  • FreeNo purchase and no fee.
  • Not a contestHavens are chosen by hand, not judged.
  • Community rules applyEvery haven is looked at before it's shown.

Who runs it

The Haven Showcase is run by Brody R., the independent developer of StepHaven, in the United States ("we" in these rules).

Apple is not a sponsor of the Haven Showcase and is not involved in it in any way. Questions go to us, not to Apple.

What it is

The Haven Showcase is a page in the Havens tab of StepHaven. Havens go up on it a few at a time, chosen by hand by us. Every StepHaven player can visit them.

This is not a contest. There are no prizes, no votes, no ranking and no judging on points. One haven may be featured as the Haven of the Day. The others appear in an order shuffled for each player.

This First Edition is a first version. How it works may change as we learn.

Who can take part

Anyone of any age who plays StepHaven on an iPhone with version 1.0.7 or later, has finished the tutorial and has played on at least 3 different days. Players under 18, or under the age of majority where they live, need a parent's or guardian's permission to take part.

The Haven Showcase is open worldwide, except where something like it isn't allowed.

Putting your name down

Put your name down from the Haven Showcase in StepHaven. It's free, and nothing of yours is shown to anyone until you choose to send a haven in. You can add a short note, which only we read.

Not everyone on the list will be invited. We invite a few keepers at a time, by letter. The letter brings the Gilded Passport cover, which is yours to keep. We don't have to give reasons for who we invite.

Sending a haven in

  • Put the Gilded Passport cover on one of your havens' passports and choose “Send to the Showcase.” One haven at a time.
  • When you send it, we keep a copy of the haven exactly as it is at that moment. Building afterwards doesn't change it. To send a newer copy, choose “Submit update for review.” The postcard that's shown only changes when we approve the update.
  • A haven you built alone is credited to your player name, or to “a StepHaven player” if you'd rather.
  • A shared haven lists every builder by name. Only the person who created it can send it in.
  • The haven must be your own work, and your friends'. Havens can be sent in and updated until the end of December 10, 2026, US Pacific time.

Being shown

We look at every haven sent in and write back by letter. We may put it on the page, or say “not yet” and why. Our decisions are final.

By sending in a haven you agree we may show its copy in StepHaven: a haven every player can visit and walk round, its picture, its name, the names it's credited to, the time of day you chose and the words you wrote. Visitors can't change your haven. Your haven and everything you built stay yours.

Taking a haven off

You can take your haven off the page at any time. Open its passport and choose “Remove postcard.”

Visitors can report a haven. After reports from three different players, it's hidden until we look at it.

We may decline a haven, take it off the page, or take back an invitation, if:

  • it breaks the community rules, in the haven, its name or its words;
  • it's someone else's work, or copied from another player;
  • it uses more than one account, or anything that gets around the game's rules;
  • anyone involved is abusive to other players or to us.

Your information

What's sent and kept when you put your name down or send a haven in is described in the privacy policy's Haven Showcase section. Step counts and health data are never part of it.

Changes

We may pause the list, invitations, sending in or the page, or change these rules, and will say so in the app and on this page.

Contact
